svg.aria-label: Flyer made entirely of low-poly triangles: Polygon Evolution, a genetic algorithm that paints with translucent polygons. On a canvas, random polygons evolve into a face while the generation counter climbs from 1 to 5000 and the Delta E error bar shrinks. CIE76 Delta E fitness, SSIM, LPIPS, FID.
